heading: State regulation prohibited
lead: A State or political subdivision of a State may not regulate or impose any requirement on pilotage on the Great Lakes.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 930646:216g Section 9306 prohibits State or local regulations of pilotage on the Great Lakes and is part of the exception provided by law envisioned under section 8501(a).
